description: A record constructor without a parameter list that validates or normalizes the components before the compiler assigns the fields.
An enum whose constants carry data passed to a constructor and which can declare its own methods.
An interface or class that limits which types may extend or implement it, so the set of cases is closed.
The clause of a sealed type that names the allowed subtypes, which the compiler infers when they share the source file.
A pattern that matches a record type and extracts its components into variables in switch or instanceof.
A switch that covers every constant or permitted subtype, so it needs no default and fails to compile when a case is missing.
A Boolean condition in a when clause that narrows a case pattern; an unguarded case with the same pattern cannot precede it.
